earnings.title: For Immediate Release
highlights: Total revenues in the third quarter of 2026 increased by four percent year-over-year to $832.5 million, compared to $799.5 million in the third quarter of 2025.

Total Tyvaso revenues increased by five percent to $503.8 million in the third quarter of 2026, as compared to $478.0 million in the third quarter of 2025, driven by growth in Tyvaso DPI revenues, partially offset by a decrease in Nebulized Tyvaso revenues.
The growth in Tyvaso DPI revenues resulted primarily from an increase in quantities sold of $43.9 million and a price increase, partially offset by higher gross-to-net deductions.
The decrease in Nebulized Tyvaso revenues resulted primarily from a decrease in U.S. quantities sold of $20.0 million, partially offset by a price increase.
The growth in Orenitram revenues resulted primarily from an increase in quantities sold of $14.9 million and a price increase, partially offset by an increase in gross-to-net deductions.

quotes.text: United Therapeutics is entering a period of extraordinary growth. We are advancing a portfolio of new therapies designed to exponentially increase the number of patients we can serve.
Our record third quarter revenue performance reflects a business operating at a very high level, driven by strong commercial momentum and focused execution across our organization.
quotes.by: Michael Benkowitz , President and Chief Operating Officer of United Therapeutics

items.heading: If our products fail in clinical trials, we will be unable to sell those products.
We may not compete successfully with established or newly developed drugs or products.

The successful commercialization of our products depends on the availability of coverage and adequacy of reimbursement from third-party payers, including governmental authorities and private health insurers. Pharmaceutical pricing and reimbursement pressures may negatively impact our sales.
Our manufacturing strategy exposes us to significant risks.
Reports of actual or perceived side effects and other adverse effects associated with our products could cause our sales to decrease or regulatory approvals to be revoked.
